hints: Evaluate L / g first, then take the square root.
Remember that 2 * pi is a pure dimensionless number.
solution: (a) [L / g] = m / (m s^-2) = s^2. (b) [sqrt(L / (2 * g))] = sqrt(s^2) = s; the constants 2*pi and sqrt(2) are dimensionless. (c) The left-hand side [T] = s matches the right-hand side, so the equation is homogeneous.
teacher_walkthrough: (a) Length L has unit m; g has unit m s^-2. Thus [L / g] = m / (m s^-2) = s^2.
(b) Taking the square root of s^2 gives s. The factors 2*pi and 1/sqrt(2) are dimensionless pure numbers.
(c) Period T is time (s). Since both sides have the base unit s, the equation is homogeneous.
